description: Introducing a Common Logo and Establishment of a ‘Scheme Owner’ for Sri Lanka Good Agricultural Practices (SL GAP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The 'Sri Lanka Good Agricultural Practices' (SL GAP) Programme was introduced by the Department of Agriculture in 2015. Through this programme, it is expected to promote food security, ensuring the sale of agro production of commercial farmers and enhance environmental sustainability through utilization of agro chemicals and other agricultural inputs in crop production at a minimum level and obtain a quality and healthy harvest. Since the authority of the Logo currently used for the SL GAP programme is vested with the Director General of Agriculture in accordance with the provisions of the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003, the name 'Department of Agriculture' is also used with that logo. The SL GAP programme needs to be expanded to cover all agricultural crops, and instead of various Ministries, Departments and Institutions using the SL GAP Logo in different ways for each crop and implementing the said programme using separate Scheme Owners, it has been identified that it would be more advantageous in Global Certification to establish a General Scheme Owner under a Common Logo unique to Sri Lanka and implement the programme.  Accordingly, the joint proposals made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation and the Minister of Plantations and Community Infrastructure to introduce one Common Logo, appoint the Secretary to the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation as Scheme Owner and establish authorized Sub Units to implement the SL GAP programme under other relevant Ministries and Institutions, were approved by the Cabinet.
